lead: A form in a drawer: the title, the fields (a `Form`) in the scrolling body, and Cancel and Save in the footer, which stays in view. `fields` describe the form as for `Form`; `onSubmit` gets the values once they are valid, and while its promise is pending Save spins. It starts from `defaultValues` every time it opens.

usage.title: Usage
usage.description: Closing is yours: close it in `onSubmit` once the save worked, so a failed save keeps the drawer, and what was typed, on screen.
usage.heading: New person

edit.title: Editing a record
edit.description: `defaultValues` fill the fields each time the drawer opens. Give the drawer a `key` when it edits another record without closing in between.
edit.heading: Edit person

conditional.title: Conditional fields
conditional.description: Everything of `Form` works: here a field is hidden until a switch is on, and while hidden it is not checked or submitted.
conditional.heading: New note

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.composed: FormDrawer is Drawer + Form + Button and has no slot of its own: its look comes from the theme styles of those components. The Save button sits in the footer, outside the `<form>`, and submits it with `form={id}`.
